coverage.denominator_note: names with a board / names probed. The denominator travels with the number every time it is quoted.

pit_rule: first_seen_utc is THIS collector's own ingest clock, never the source's updated_at/createdAt/publishedAt -- those are index-state fields an ATS can backfill silently, and a feature stamped on one would read the future in a way no test would catch.
n_new_is_new_to_us: n_new_since_last counts job ids absent from OUR cursor, and is None on a board's first observation rather than n_open -- otherwise the series carries a spike on the day we started looking.
